tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra kī la ya/ bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ /spyi bos phyag 'tshal sku gsum zhal ldan zhing / /phyag drug zhabs bzhi'i 'gro drug bdud bzhi 'dul/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /smin byed dbang bzhis rdo rje slob ma yi/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa rab sbyangs te/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rtsa ba gang / /dbang gi mtshams sbyor dga' ba skyed byed bri/ /de la rdo rje phur pa'i slob ma dbang bskur gyi mtshams sbyor brda sprod blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed 'di la gnyis te/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po sta gon ni/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rnams/ kho bos byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo gros kha 'byed bzhin byas la/ slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ mchod g.yog pas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab cing gnas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang du/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i chos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i khams dang / bsam pa dang /

bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad rigs su bsdu na theg pa dman pa dang / theg pa chen po gnyis sam/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin la/ de yang gsang sngags gsar ma ltar na slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas rgyud sde gsum du bzhag pa dang / slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pas bzhir bzhag pa dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis lngar bshad pa dang / slob dpon lū hi pa sogs kyis drug tu bzhag pa sogs bshad tshul mang na yang / da lan gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs ltar na/ theg pa rim pa dgu'i rnam gzhag mdzad do/ /de yang thun mong ba pha rol tu phyin pa la theg pa gsum ste/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ theg pa chen po'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags la drug ste/ kri ya/ u pa/ yo ga ni/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la/ phyi'i rgyud sde gsum mam theg pa/ mahā yo ga rnal 'byor chen po ste thabs kyi rgyud/ a nu yo ga shin tu rnal 'byor te shes rab kyi rgyud/ a ti yo ga rjes su rnal 'byor te gnyis su med pa'i rgyud ni nang gi rgyud sde gsum mam theg pa ste dgu'i tha snyad mdzad pa las/ 'dir a nu yo ga rjes su rnal 'byor zhes pa ma rgyud sgo drug tu gnas pa la 'phrin las kyi rigs phur bu rtsa ba'i rgyud rdo rje khros pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud dam/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud kyi rdo rje'i rigs kyi le'u zur du phyung ba las/ phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bur grags pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas shang sreg shing dgon par gter nas spyan drangs shing rang bsgyur mdzad pa 'di ni rtsa ba'i rgyud yin zhing / karma ma la las kyi phreng ba ni bshad rgyud kyi cha tsam yin pas de dag nas bshad pa'i lam gyi srol/

bstan pa snga dar la lugs mang du byung na'ang / 'dir slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel/ sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang phur thun mong gi sgrub thabs/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i phur pa'i tho yig de dag gi gsal byed dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtogs par sla ba/ de'i zur 'debs rin po che'i do shal dang / sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed gnyis/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rnams la brten nas dpal sa skya pa'i bka' srol rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje phur pa lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ stod las dang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang gnyis las da lan stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi rdzogs su rdzogs par bskur bar bya ba la/ dkyil chog las/ sngon 'gro gang zag gnas dang ni/ /sa chog sta gon rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pas dang po gang zag gi mtshan nyid ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mdzad pa ste/ slob dpon ni/ blo yang rgyud la goms pa dang / /ting 'dzin las su rung ba dang / /phyi nang sde snod thams cad la/ /som nyi med cing the tshom med/ /gsang ba sbas pa'i thabs mchog rnams/ /snod ngan rnams la mi spel zhing / /zab mo'i dbang mchog thob pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid ci rigs pa dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa las su rung ba gcig gis bya dgos la/ slob ma yang / rkyen thub mi bzlog mtshan nyid can/ /shes rab rnam gsum sgo nas sbyangs/ /man ngag lung la rtag dga' zhing / /des shing 'jam la snyan par smra/ /thabs dang shes rab zab mo'i don/ /gnyis med don la mi skrag cing / /slob dpon dag la gus byed pa/

/dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid ci rigs pa dang ldan pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du zung du ma gyur pa zhig la mdzad pa phyag len lags/ gnyis pa gnas ni/ las bzhi dang rjes su mthun zhing yid du 'ong ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig bya dgos shing / gsum pa sa chog ni/ sngar ma byas pa'i sa dang / phyag len mi nyams pa'i phyir rdul tshon sogs rgyas par mdzad pa'i skabs su bya dgos la dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa dang / ras bris sogs bsdus pa'i dus ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pas de ltar shes par bya zhing / bzhi pa sta gon la thig gdab pa/ lha sta gon/ slob ma sta gon rnams las/ sa'i lha mo sta gon dngos su ma bshad kyang sa chog ma byas pa'i sar/ sa byin rlabs kyi skabs bzhin 'dir kha bskangs nas mdzad pas/ sta gon dang po rnams ni slob dpon kho nas bya ba'i las yin pas ci rigs pa sngon du song nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la dkyil chog las/ spro bskyed sdom bzung byin gyis brlab/ /so shing dri chu chos bshad pa/ /ku sha srung skud gtor ma gtang / /mchod sogs rmi brtag cho ga 'o/ /zhes pa ltar don tshan rnam pa bcu gcig gis bsdus pa las/ dang po spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu tshur gsang ba'i cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni gsang ba'i snod yin te/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir mdzad pa'i tshul/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ khyed rnams la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos nas/ khyed rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i snod dang ldan pa ni skal pa bzang ba yin te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs pa'i shul lam/

bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin te/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang 'di la brten nas 'tshang rgya/ da ltar gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po yang nang ltar du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la brten nas srod la bdud btul/ tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba yin pas/ khyed rnams kyang lam 'di lta bu dang phrad pa ni skal pa bzang ba yin pas blo 'di las gzhan du mi 'gyur bar dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig de ltar spro ba bskyed nas/ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin pa'i thog mar/ bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis su med pa la sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro zhing dam bca' ba/ sdig pa bshags pa/ rjes su yi rang ba/ sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi yi bar brjod/ de ltar thun mong gi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bzung nas/ thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /nas/ byang chub gnas su bsgral bar bgyi yi bar lan gsum brjod/ de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bzung nas khas blangs nas/

gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rdo rje gzhon nu dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bskal pa'i me lta bu tsha la rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la slob dpon gyis oṃ kī li kī la ya sarba bighan+na ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me phung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu 'dril zhing / dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs bzhi bgrad nas bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba'i bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rdo rje gsor/ kī la ya lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg pa la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad las bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slob ma rnams kyi dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du/ lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mos dri'i thig le re byas la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

āḥzhes brjod pas mgrin par āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po re gsal lam ste byung bar thams cad kyis mos pa mdzod cig zhes brjod nas thams cad la tshar ba dang / khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad yi ge 'bru gsum dang / 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum la thim pas/ tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum thams cad sbyangs nas/ lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams lhar bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ thog mar me tog dbu la dbul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ nas 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru slob ma rnams kyi mgor gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ dang / de bzhin du dhū pes bdug spos shangs la/ ā lo kes mar me spyan lam du/ gan+dhes dri chu 'thor yab kyis thugs khar gtor/ de ltar mchod pa rgyas pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ bzhi pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir so shing sbyin dgos pas so shing las bum gyi chu dang / kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa/ rtse mor me tog dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ kī la ya dang / oṃ dzi hoḥbadz+ra saṃ brta ni swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum tsam brjod cing / de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i so shing de nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang /

sngags rting ma dzi hos sbyin tshar ba dang / so shing de nyid rgyu rin po che gser ram/ dngul las byas par mos nas/ so shing gi rtse mo sos nem gyis drud pa la brten nas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin du skyugs par mos/ gral rim bzhengs nas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'di'i steng du zhabs bzhag slob dpon la zhal phyogs pa'i tshul gyis oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes gsungs shing tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du 'dor bar zhu/ slob ma re re nas dor ba dang bstun/ shar du bstan na zhi ba'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod par bya/ de bzhin du rtse mo phyogs mtshams steng 'og gang la bstan byung rim gyis 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lung bstan/ thams cad kyis dor tshar ba dang / de ltar so shing gi rtse mo de nyid/ rang dang bla ma la bstan na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur la/ shar du bstan na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa 'og gi gter mthong ba la sogs pa/ mtshams su bstan na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub ci rigs thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dngos grub kyi ltas brtag slob dpon gyis so shing byin rlabs dang / slob ma la 'gyed pa'i bar las kyi rdo rjes/ slob dpon gyi mdun du dri bzang gi chus khru bzhi tsam byugs pa'i dbus su/ nas kyi tshom bu che ba gcig dang / phyogs mtshams ngos 'dzin pa'i phyir phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu chung bar ma 'khrul bar bkod pa so shing dor ba'o/ /de'i 'phrin las slob dpon la zhal phyogs par re gas pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po gong sdom bzung gi bar la bris pa slob ma'i zhabs 'jog pa yin/ lnga pa kha dag par bya ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dung chos su dri bzang gi chu sbyar ba la ki la ya dang /

'bru gsum lan gsum tsam bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i dri chu de nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi khyor ba g.yas par lan gsum du sbyin pa la brten nas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / dri'i chu khyor ba lan gsum sbyin zhing / oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhe sarba dharma/ sarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thams cad la sbyin tshar ba dang / drug pa zab mo'i chos bshad pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas/ /sdig sgrib rnam smin mang po kun/ /de dag zad par 'gyur ba ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyis sang nyin dkyil 'khor gyi tshon rtsi tsam mthong ba'i mod la yang / bskal pa bye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur ba yin na/ ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par byin gyis brlab pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs la/ dbang bskur ba tshul bzhin nos na/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur bas dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig de ltar chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed do/ /bdun pa rmi lam mi 'khrug cing gsal po 'byung ba'i don du ku sha'i sngas stan sbyin pa ni/ ku sha che chung gnyis gong bzhin bum chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa de nyid sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang che ba de nyid stan gyi don du phyag g.yon par sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / dhīḥha zhes pa thams cad la sbyin tshar ba dang / brgyad pa rmi lam dang dngos grub bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud sna lnga bum chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu kha dog sna lnga pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa lnga sgril du byas pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa lnga btab/ de la hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā lnga bkod pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ……lha sta gon gyi dgong yin na/ sta gon gyi lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas zer/ gzhan dkyus bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te yig 'bru rnams la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas srad bu la thim pas/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi srad bur gyur/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā/ lan gsum tsam bzlas/ de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i srad bu de nyid skyes pa rnams kyis dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med rnams kyis g.yas su bcings pa la brten nas bar chad thams cad srung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing / 'ching dus kī la ya dang / bcings tshar ba dang 'khyil sngags a mṛ ta brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes las bum gyi chu mdud pa'i steng du ku shas gtor/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzhag cing sarba bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣaḥrak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa thams cad la tshar ba dang / de ltar srung skud bcings nas/ dgu pa slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin dgos pas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ mchod gtor rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs pa nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bar/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma ji bzhin la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /gdangs dang rol mo mi mdzad/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i rjes la/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ zhes pa skabs thob dang bstun gzhan rol mo sogs 'dra/ de ltar gtor ma btang nas/ bcu pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la mchod pa ni/ sgeg phreng glu gar gyis phyi mchod rol mo dang bcas pa/

rang byung gdod nas sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis nang mchod phul nas de ltar phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod de/ bcu gcig pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung bar bya ba'i don du/ khyed rang rnams do nub rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i mal zhig bcas nas nyal bar bya ste/ spyi rgyud las/ ku sha gting ba'i sa phyogs su/ /shar phyogs mgo bstan nyal du gzhug /ces dang / mgon po mya ngan 'das gzim ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar bya/ /shes bzhin myur du ldang sems la/ /dang po nyid du nges par sbyar/ /zhes gsung pas na/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi steng du phrad la legs par gting / che ba de nyid stan gyi steng du dkyus la bting nas mgo shar ram byang / dge ba'i phyogs yin par bstan/ yang bla ma dang rten bzhugs pa yin na de'i phyogs gang la gtad kyang nyes pa med pas/ de ltar du shes par byas nas gos gsar pa dri ma med pa gyon te/ seṅge'i nyal stabs zhes pa glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dang / rnam par rtog pa gang yang yid la ma bsam par/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor chen po ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur ram snyam pa'i dga' spro sang nge nyal ba dang / rmi lam du lung bstan par 'gyur te de yang / rmi lam thams cad bden min yang / /de la ma dad rigs ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ spyir 'jig rten du rmi lam zhes pa mi bden pa'i dper 'dzin yang / dbang bskur ba'i dus dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas lung ston par mdzad pas/ de yang srod kyi cha nyin bar gyi snang ba'i bag chags dang 'dres pas cung mi gsal zhing / nam gung gnyid mthug po zhes rmi lam mi 'byung / de nas tho rangs kyi cha'i rmi lam brtag dgos pas/ de la rmi lam bzang po'i ltas ni/ rang gi sems la dbang thob dang / /sna tshogs sprul pa ston pa dang / /'gro gang dbang du 'dus pa dang /

/rdzu 'phrul dag gis 'gro ba dang / /sa la mi thogs chur mi 'bying / /nam mkha' dag la bya bzhin 'phur/ /sems can mang po bsgral ba dang / /g.yul ngo dag las rab rgyal ba/ /zhes gsungs pas rang gi sems la dbang thob ste/ sprul pa sna tshogs bstan pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su bgrod de/ sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyis ri rwa ba sogs la chags thogs med par 'gro nus shing / chu bo'i steng la phyin pas mi nub pa dang / nam mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur te sems can mang po bsgral zhing 'gro kun dbang du 'dus pa dang / dmag gi tshogs bshams te dgra bo thams cad pham par byas nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la chos kyi bka' drin nod pa ni mchog dam par gyur pa yin la/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs mthong ba/ mchod rten dag la skor ba byed pa/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'brel gtam byed pa/ dar 'phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa/ ri mthon po la 'dzegs pa/ brag phug kha byang bstan du nyi ma lde ba/ khri mthon po la 'dzegs nas mang po'i dpon du bkur ba/ lus las ngan skyugs thon pa sogs rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sdig pa dag cing dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum thob pa'i ltas su shes par byas la/ zhen chags med pa'i ngang nas dga' ba bsgom par bya/ gal te ngan pa yang 'byung srid pas/ rmi lam ngan pa'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzeg pa/ ka ra wa ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ bye ma'i thal phung gi ri la 'dzegs pa/ bong bu la zhon nas kha lho phyogs su bltas te slar mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / spre'u la zhon te kha shar phyogs su bltas nas slar mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba/ bud med nag mo rab tu khros pas rang gi lto ba dbral ba/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyad pa/ lus la til mar gyis byugs shing / gos dmar po gyon pa/ phreng ba dmar po thod du bcings rgyan dmar pos brgyan pa/

mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ g.yang sa dang grog rong du lhung ba/ skra bregs pa/ chus 'khyer ba/ nyi zla gzas bzung ba sogs rmi na/ cung rmi lam ngan pa yin pas de nyid bzlog par byed pa'i thabs la gnyid sad ma thag chos thams cad lta ba bdag med pas sbyang dgos te/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos gang zhe na/ rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ de las gzhan pa'i chos shig yod na'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu zhes gsungs pas/ lta ba bdag med pas sbyangs nas/ gzhan su la'ang ma smras par slob dpon la zhus te/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa zhus te rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa dang / bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing / mi dge ba la zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg zhi ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhi drag sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad du 'bul ba la sogs pa/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis nub dang po sta gon gyi chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ sang nyin dngos gzhi ni skabs su ji ltar bab pa las 'byung bas de la mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod nas slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gtor bsngo sogs cho ga rnams phyag len bzhin grub nas/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ nang du 'ong dus/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bsil/ ki la ya bzla/ gzhan las slob rnams kyis rol mo dang gu gul gyis bdugs la bgegs bskrad/ de nas slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog gi bkye bsdu tshar ba dang slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i lam rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu zab par gyur pa ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin zhing / de yang snga 'gyur ltar du bshad cing nyams su len pa'i tshul lam/ gsang sngags rnying ma dang / gsar ma gnyis las/ rnying ma'i lugs yin zhing / de la lam skor du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ rdo rje phur pa'i skor yin la/ de la yang slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ 'khon klu'i dbang po las brgyud pa sa lugs su grags pa/ khyi nag gyang 'gyel gyi lugs/ phur pa jo mo lugs/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i lugs rnams su yod pa las/ 'di 'khon klu'i dbang po nas brgyud pa phur pa sa lugs yin zhing / de la bshad lugs kyi dbang du byas na/ phur pa rgyud ltar bshad pa/ phur pa lung ltar bshad pa/ phur pa man ngag ltar bshad pa ste bshad thabs rnam pa gsum/ rgyud kyi bsdu thabs rnam pa gnyis/ khog don drug them sbyor bcu/ gnad tho bcu gnyis/ srog thems nyer gcig rnams su yod kyang / de dag hril gyis bsdu na/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ stod las yin zhing / de la yang chu bo bzhi 'dus pa'i sgo nas bshad cing nyams su len dgos te/ chu bo bzhi zhes pa ni/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo skur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭīka stong thun dang bcas pa/ gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo lag len mngon rtogs dang bcas pa/ man ngag gnad kyi chu bo dris lan gegs sel dang bcas pa rnams yin pa las/ thog mar smin byed dbang gi chu bo sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas lam rnams nyams su len dgos te/ de yang / dbang ma bskur la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/

/dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal ba skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes dang / dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par rtogs na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyi grol ba min/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig gsungs pas/ dbang ma thob par gsang sngags zab mo'i lam 'chad pa dang / nyams su len pa sogs gang byas na'ang phan yon mi 'byung ba'i khar nyes dmigs ches lci ba gcig 'byung bas na/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gang yang rung bar dbang bskur dgos shing / de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon ni/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun du ni/ /ma bsgom par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces dang / gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon du ma zhig dang ldan pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu bo skur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa'i sgo nas mngon par dbang bskur ba bsgrub par bya dgos la/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba thob nas lam de nyams su blangs pas/ mthar 'bras bu gang mngon du byed na/ phur pa'i rgyu bzhi/ gang zag rnam pa bzhi'i mthar dbyung zhes gsung ste/ nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa yul chos dbyings la gdab/ ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis tshad med snying rje'i phur pa'am/ thugs rje sprul pa'i phur pa khams gsum gyi sems can la gdab/ bya ka lan+ta ka lta bu'i gang zag gis gsang ba byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la gdab/ tsan+dan sdong po lta bu'i gang zag gis mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar gdab pa la sogs pa nyams su blangs pa la brten te/

mthar 'bras bu sku bzhi'am kun tu bzang po'i rigs gang yang rung ba thob par 'gyur bas na/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo bsgrub par bya ba la/ sta gon du gnas pa dang / dngos gzhir gnas pa gnyis las/ sta gon gyi chos 'khor dang bcas pa kha sang nas kyis gnas skabs su song nas/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su bab pa yin zhing / de la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyis bsgrubs nas slar slob dpon gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ste/ he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can gyis/ phyi rol du phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin zhing / nang du log ste nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis kyang / slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba bdag 'jug gi tshul du len dgos pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mchod gtor gyis mnyes pa'i bar dgos pa 'khor dang bcas pa legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / zhugs nas dbang bskur ba gnyis las 'jug pa yin zhing / de la yang phyi dang nang gnyis las/ phyi'i 'jug pa'i thog mar spro ba dri ba yin te/ bu khyod tshur shog ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ /de'i lan gdab par mos nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la/ /bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rab tu dga' bas 'tshal lags so/ /zhes tshar gcig brjod/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ slob dpon langs te dril bu bsil zhing / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas chas su gzhug par bya ba'i phyir/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma gzigs pa'am gzigs kyang bskyar nas gzigs pa mtshon byed du dar yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong ras rnams 'gyed tshar ba dang / khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas na/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi chun 'phyang chen po re yang gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / ā khaṃ bi ra hūm̐ gis me tog tsam pa ka 'gyed tshar ba dang / slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / sgo ma bzhi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba la phyi'i bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi sogs sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang / a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil sngags brjod/ ku shas las bum gyi chu gtor ro/ /de ltar phyi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrungs nas bdud rtsi byin zhing nang gi bar chad thams cad srung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing gong du sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi nas sbyin/ de ltar phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrungs nas nang gi sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bu cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba dang bcas pa ste/ bden pa gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi/ de nyid slob dpon gyis snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje reg la oṃ su ra te sogs brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams bla ma dang rdo rje gzhon nu gnyis su med pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis phyi'i 'jug pa song nas/ nang 'jug gi thog ma/ khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gsol ba gdab dgos pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /sogs lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon langs te zhwa phud dril bsil bya/ /mchod g.yog pas yol ba sogs bsal/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo khang nas yar zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa re mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ de nas slob dpon gyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas sgo ma bzhi'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ sgo rnams rim gyis phye nas/ gtso bo'i drung du 'khrid pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs skor ba byas nas/ shar gyi sgo drung nas 'khod bzhin pas/ rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag btsal bar mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod nas/ de ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs te dbang bskur ba tshul bzhin du nos nas/ dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad 'dzin dgos pas/ de la 'dzin rgyu'i ngo bo 'di dang 'di'o zhes bsgrags pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba 'o/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyed kyis bzung bar bgyi/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su grags/ /slob ma khyed kyis bzung bar bgyi/

/bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di la brnyas par ma byed cig /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig go /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba 'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig tu dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu rdo rje/ dril bu/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid/ rdo rje slob dpon dang bzhi mi 'bral bar 'dzin dgos/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig tu bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus rnam pa drug tu sems can gyi don byed pa dang / 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum zhes pa/ phyi bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa nas bshad pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams dang / theg pa gsum zhes pa nyan thos rang rgyal pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de dag nas bshad pa'i dam pa'i chos ma lus pa bzung ba dang / don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu de thams cad kyi steng du dran shes bzhin bsten pa dang / dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la mchod pa'i las ci nus su bya dgos so/ de ltar bsgrags nas bzung ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces pa nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ba gnyis slob ma sta gon bzhin byas la/

de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams legs par bzung nas/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa la sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa bzhi dang / dngos gnyis las/ thog mar phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ rigs kyi bu mchog tshur nyon cig /sogs brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /sogs brjod/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'am/ mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob ma rnams la gong du bshams pa'i dri bzang la nang mchod bsres pa sbyin zhing / 'di ni khyed kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /sogs brjod/ bzhi pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam pa la bzhag pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te thams cad du/ /sogs brjod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa song nas/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ sogs brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ mahā shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched tha mal pa rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas 'khor lo/

g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i zhabs bzhi bgrad pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu/ chang zung thur du bstan zhing mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba/ sum mdor raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying gar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang / lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par waṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la a yis mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su ha yis mtshan pa ste 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gsal lam ste btab nas/ slob dpon la rdo rje gzhon nu dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rkang mthil gyi yi ge dzhaiṃ mer dmar hur gyis 'bar/ long bu'i rtsa nang nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug khyug song / sum mdor gzhir gnas kyi me dang phrug chil te 'dres pas drag tu 'bar te de'i stobs kyis snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor tsha laṃ laṃ bsregs/ de'i drod kyis mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor skya thi li li bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung la phog pas de g.yos/ thur du bus te mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor de las bdud rtsi zegs ma sa'i dkyil 'khor la sib sib thim pas bde ba dang lte ba'i drod skyes te/ snying gar bde drod 'dzoms pa la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa la sems gtad/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas/

rdo rje gnod sbyin mo mdog dkar mo pu shud kyi mgo bo can/ lcags kyu dang phur bu thogs pa mang du spros te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi tshogs tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ de'i dus su khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar btegs/ ha cang nam mkha' la 'gro/ spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan te/ lus bar snang du 'dar yed yed gnas pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang / ba spu'i bu ga nas kha ba chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib babs pa la brten nas/ dbang gi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ lan gsum brjod/ dril gsil rol mo gu gul gyis bdug cing / tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha sogs yang yang brjod/ rol mo bzhag la/ de lta bu'i ye shes pa de nyid sku babs na 'phar ba dang g.yo ba/ gsung phebs na saṃ skri ta'i skad smra zhing dgod pa/ thugs phebs na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la lhan gyis 'gro ba sogs/ nyams myong cung zad tsam re mi skye mi srid pas de nyid ma brjed par byas nas lam gyi dus su bskyang dgos so/ /de nyid slob dpon gyis spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing slob ma re re'i mgor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag tshar ba dang / khyed rang rnams nam mkha'i kha dog la brten nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag dgos pas/ mig mig ras dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi nam mkha' 'dom gang khor yug tsam la bltas pa de'i tshe/ rang rang gi kha dog gi mthong snang ci byung ba de smra dgos pas na/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang / zhes rim pas dri/ slob mas dkar po zhes zer na/

slob dpon gyis zhi ba'i las 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod/ de bzhin du ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang / sngon po mngon spyod/ nag po drag po/ ljang khu dang khra bo la las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /da khyed rang rnams kyi phyag na yod pa'i me tog gi phreng ba rnams thogs te/ gral rim bzhin bzhengs nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i gtso bo nas/ me ri'i bar ye shes kyi snang ba gcig las grub pas bzang ngan dang / mchog dman med mod/ 'on kyang rang gi las 'brel bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog snyam du/ oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsungs shing gtso bo'i dbu thog tu phul ba'i mos pa tsam mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog phyag tu blangs/ gdong phye ste/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /sogs sngags bcas brjod/ me tog de nyid slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sogs nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ zhes pa'i bar thams cad la brjod tshar ba dang / de ltar na khyed rang rnams kyis pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog phul/ slob dpon gyis/ sngon gyi mig mkhan sogs kyis mig ras phye ste/ khyed rang rnams kyis mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas/ ye shes kyi mig thob ste thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /ces sogs kyis me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas spyi bor bzhag pas/ dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i mos pa mdzod/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul te/ de la yang dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa dang / rnam dag bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /nas/ gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/

/zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de la yang mtshan nyid bstan pa dang / rnam dag bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ de yang phyi rol rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug to/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar/ pad+ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan/ rtsibs rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ steng du tshangs pa pho mo/ shar du brgya byin pho mo/ de bzhin du lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du bgegs bdag 'og tu sa bdag pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan dang / sgo bzhir yang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan/ phyi'i khor yug la dbang phyug ma rnams la za 'og gi 'bol/ dam can ma rnams la mtshams bzhir khrag mtsho ste/ rten gzhal yas khang pa dang / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me phung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab kyi phur bu 'dril zhing / dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can gyis bzhugs pa/

steng gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la hūm̐ chen ka ra sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa phag gi mgo can dang / g.yon du rmigs bu'i mgo can gyis gnas pa/ shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog mthing ga mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas yum rdo rje sgeg mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa stag gi mgo can dang / g.yon du bya rgod mgo can gyis gnas pa/ me'i 'khor lo rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po dbyug sngon can sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje sder mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa g.yag gi mgo can dang / g.yon du bya rog gi mgo can gyis gnas pa/ lho'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la/ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed sku mdog sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje dur khrod ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa shwa ba'i mgo can dang / g.yon du 'ug pa'i mgo can gyis gnas pa/ lho nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon sku mdog mthing ga mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje gtun khung ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa gzig gi mgo can dang / g.yon du khwa ta'i mgo can gyis gnas pa/ nub kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la/ khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal po sku mdog dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje gtum mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa byi la'i mgo can dang / g.yon du pu shud kyi mgo can gyis gnas pa/ nub byang gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa sku mdog dkar po/

dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje mda' snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa spyang ki'i mgo can dang / g.yon du khra'i mgo can gyis gnas pa/ byang gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje sgra mdzad ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa seng ge'i mgo can dang / g.yon du pha wang gi mgo can gyis gnas pa/ byang shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs gdan la/ khro bo chen po khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog ser po/ ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas/ yum rdo rje gsod byed ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa dred kyi mgo can dang / g.yon du sre mong mgo can gyis gnas pa/ 'og gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi gdan la khro bo chen po stobs po che sku mdog du ba'i mdog can/ rtsa zhal dud ka g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug dang ldan pas yum rdo rje rig byed ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i g.yas su sprul pa dom gyi mgo can dang / g.yon du byi ba'i mgo can gyis gnas pa/ shar sgor rdo rje gnod sbyin mo mdog pu shud kyi mgo can g.yas su lcags kyu/ g.yon phur bu 'dril ba/ byang sgor rdo rje gsod byed ma kha dog ljang khu khra'i mgo can g.yas dril bu/ g.yon phur bu 'dril ba/ gtso bo'i mdun du badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir shar lhor bud+dha he ru ka smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ lho nub tu rat+na he ru ka ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ nub byang du pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ byang du karma he ru ka ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang / dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi dam can gyi snam bu'i gdan la shar du dbang phyug ma dkar mo bdun/

lhor ser mo bdun/ nub tu dmar mo bdun/ byang du ljang khu bdun rnams rim pa bzhin/ phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ rgya gram rnams 'dzin zhing / g.yon du phur bu 'dril ba/ mtshams rnams su khrag mtsho la dam can bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi ste mdor na bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad sku dang / tsaka li lta bu ma yin pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal lam ste gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin/ rnam dag bstan pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis zhugs shing mthong ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa de rnams spang bya dang lam gyi chos gang rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin snyam na/ 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ gzhal yas gru bzhir gyur pa ni/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ni rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam par dag pa yin la brten pa lha'i rnam dag ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /zhes pa nas/ btang snyoms rnam par dag pa'o zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ni lha'i rnam dag bstan pa'o/ /de ltar na 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pas lam lnga las tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis ni lha dang skal pa mnyam par bya ba'i phyir/ 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ dbang gi dngos gzhi la bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa rnams su yod pa las/ bum dbang de la slob ma dang slob dpon gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs sh+lau ka gcig po brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas sngon du 'gro ba byur bsal ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du seng ge'i khri/ pad+ma nyi ma/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la khyed rang rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bar skabs kyi tshig rnams ye shes dbab pa bzhin no/ /de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pa la brten nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing slob dpon gyis dril bu bsil/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mos sgra bya/ kī la ya brjod do/ /de rnams kyis sngon du 'gro ba byur bsal ba'i cho ga song nas/ dngos gzhi mngon par dbang bskur ba bsgrub par bya ba la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga'i thog ma mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ kro ngha a mṛ ta dang /

slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chus slob ma dang dbang rdzas la gtor zhing kro ngha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas la thim/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la slob dpon gyis mchod cing bstod dgos pas oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ nghu pe/ gan+dhe/ nai w-i d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da pha la ya/ bispu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / dril bsil bya zhing / mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ de ltar mchod cing bstod de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs nas/ khyed rang rnams dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha slob dpon dang bcas pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces dang / che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /sogs dbyangs dang bcas pa tshar gcig brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma re re'i mgo thog tu bum pa bzhag bum chu sbyin zhing / che ba'i sogs brjod/ tshar ba dang zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ khyed rang rnams mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra a ra li hūm̐ nas/ biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod g.yog pas mchod pa rnam lnga bshams pas slob ma rnams la bskor zhing / ji ltar rigs pa'i slob ma'i mdun du bzhag dril bu bsil la rol chen bya/ de ltar na khyed rnams mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rin chen 'byung ldan cod paṇa gyi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob ma dang / dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ swa las rin po che swas mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs dang / gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rnam par sogs nas/ dbang rdzas la mchod pa'i bar dril gsil sogs gong bzhin/ lta ba ngan pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sogs brjod/ mchod cing bstod de sogs thams cad la 'dra/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i cod paṇa du gyur/ dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams kyis sogs 'dra/ rin po che'i cod paṇa thogs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rgyan/ /sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa swa'i bar brjod cing slob ma re re la dbu rgyan bskon tshar ba dang / de'i mtha' rten du dar dpyangs kyis kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ badz+ra rā ga ta/ badz+ra sha li ho/ zhes brjod cing dar dpyangs sna lnga re dbu rgyan gyi steng du bskon/ dbu rgyan gnyis las med na dar dpyangs dbu rgyan dang lhan cig gtad/ sngags rnams sbrel nas bya/ de'i mtha' rten du bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes rnam rgyal bum chu nas slob ma re re'i spyi bor ku shas gtor la/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ de la mchod pa rol mo sogs gong bzhin la/ ak+ṣo bh+ya'i gnas su rat+na sam+bha wa bcug de ltar na khyed rang rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod paṇa gyi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi don du sogs dang / khyed rang rnams dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā las pad+ma ās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs dang / gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang 'od dpag med kyi rnam par sogs nas/

dbang rdzas la mchod pa'i bar dril gsil sogs gong bzhin/ rdo rje'i gsung ni dpag med pa/ /sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa gong bzhin/ 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rdo rje thogs nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sogs sngags bcas brjod/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gtad tshar ba dang / rin chen 'byung ldan ltar bum chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa la oṃ a mri ta bhā wa hrī/ gzhan rol mo sogs 'dra/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med pa'i sgo nas rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi don du sogs dang / khyed rang rnams dang / dbang rdzas dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs dang / ha las ral gri has mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / don yod grub pa'i rnam par sogs nas/ dbang rdzas la mchod pa'i dril gsil gyi bar gong bzhin/ rdo rje las rab kun gyi gtso/ /sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ gsol ba 'debs pa gong bzhin/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin gyi dril bu thogs nas/ 'di ni shes rab kun gyi dngos/ /sogs sngags bcas brjod cing dkrol te/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par gtad tshar ba dang gong bzhin/ bum chus dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa la oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi/ gzhan rol mo sogs 'dra/

de ltar khyed rnams don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi don du sogs dang / khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs phung dang / dbang rdzas rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las sogs dang / oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ gnyis ka'ang rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang / dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par sogs nas dbang rdzas la mchod pa'i dril gsil bar gong bzhin/ rdo rje'i sku ni dga' chen po sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bur gyur/ dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa gong bzhin/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dang dril bu lag pa g.yas pas gnyis ka bzung la dkrol zhing / 'di ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu mngags pa gsang ba'i ming / /kyai zhes slob ma re re la gsang mtshan dris/ slob mas dpal mi bskyod rdo rje zer na/ slob dpon gyis/ mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i/ /ming gis khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /zhes rigs 'gre thams cad la shes par bya'o/ /gsang mtshan med pa rnams la/ gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar btags shing brjod/ thams cad la tshar ba dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ gong bzhin bum chus dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa la oṃ bai ro tsa ni/ gzhan rol mo sogs 'dra/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug dag

gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /bdag po'i dbang gi don du sogs/ slob ma rnams kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ bum chu mi 'thor/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/ khyed rang rnams hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu zhes pa nas/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i bar gong bzhin/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / thod pa āḥlas ka pa la bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pa de nyid/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yon du gtad pa la brten nas/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob ma rnams lag pa bsnol ba'i g.yas su rdo rje dang / g.yon du thod pa gtad cing / shes rab pad+ma'i snod yin te/ sogs sngags bcas brjod tshar ba dang / de ltar na dbang rnam pa drug gi sgo nas kun gzhi'i dri ma bsal zhing / ma rig pa nyon mongs pa drug dag nas/ rig pa rigs drug gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis slob ma'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum du mdzod/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ sogs brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rdor dril gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyag na yod pa'i rdor dril rnams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang /

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dril bu a las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur pa de nyid/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i phyag g.yas g.yon du byin pa la brten nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi dam tshig gsum po gcig tu sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag gi rdor dril blangs te/ thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang / /sogs sngags bcas brjod/ dril bu bsil zhing / rdor dril slob ma'i lag g.yas g.yon du gtad/ thams cad la tshar ba dang / de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas na yod pa'i rdo rje de nyid thugs kar sku 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis bzung / g.yon pas dril bu de nyid dku g.yon pa'i thad du kha gyen du phyogs pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs sngags bcas dang / a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis sogs sngags bcas brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams phyag gnyis thugs kar 'khyud pa'i stangs ka yang mdzad par zhu/ shes rab bcu drug sogs dang / rdo rje che dang dril bu che sogs brjod/ rdo rje gtad pa ni sems thabs bde ba'i ye shes su byin gyis rlob par byed pa rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gtad pa ni/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig

khyed rang rnams rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig ste/ dam tshig gsum po stabs cig tu thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bas don gyi bum pa'i dbang skur ba thob pa yin no/ /dbang de dag bstan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /sogs sngags bcas brjod cing / ku shas rnam rgyal bum chu slob ma re re'i spyi bor gtor/ de ltar na bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa he ru kas gtso mdzad pa'i khro bo rigs lngas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pa de nyid/ slob dpon gyis kyang rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob ma re re'i mgor me tog gtor zhing / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ khyed rnams rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis mchod pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra/ a ha ra li sogs dril gsil rol chen/ mchod pas bskor nas ci bder bzhag go /de nas las kyi rdo rjes rdor dril/ dbu rgyan sogs bsdus/ de ltar mchod pas mchod nas/ bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar kī la ya skra shad kyis bris pa lta bus bskor nas yod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyis tshul du byung /

slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dang pos thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ kī la ya gsum brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbu thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes slob ma mang nyung dang bstun nas brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas skabs su phyag len la yang mdzad cing / dam bca' len par spro na/ slob ma re re'i mdun du phyin nas/ slob dpon gyi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug nas/ nyi ma re la kī la ya du zla zhes dris tshar ba dang / khyed rang rnams dus da nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing / de'i gsang sngags kyang dam bca' byas nas dam bca' bzhin dang / ma byas na nyi ma re la ci nus kyis bzla bar bya'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ rang gi ming nas brjod de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing / de'i gsang sngags kyang nyi ma re la ci nus sam/ dam bca' bzhin bzla bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni/ /zhes pa nas/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar spyi 'gros ltar brjod cing me tog gtor la rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

de nas rig lnga'i sprul bshad sbyin pa ni/ khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa la 'khor lo phyag tu gtad nas rjes su gnang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ 'khor lo bris pa'i tsaka li slob ma rnams kyi lag tu gtad la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul gyur pa'i/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo skor/ /de bzhin du mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la sna tshogs rdo rje'i tsaka li bris pa rnams gong bzhin gtad/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs tshigs bcad kyi skabs su rdo rje'i 'khor lo sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba dkyil chog bzhin dang / de nas 'bud dung phrug gu slob ma rnams la gtad cing / 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /khyod kyis chos kyi dung bus shig /ces brjod cing 'bud pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ thams cad la gtad tshar ba dang / de ltar na khyed kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no zhes pa'i bar dang / de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes skabs thob dang sbyar nas rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i bar kho bos byas pa'i dkyil chog bzhin brjod/ de rnams kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /sogs brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re/ slob dpon la phyag rgyar phul ba'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyed zhabs pad+mo'i sogs tshar gcig brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdzas gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gdong ras rnams bcing bar zhu/ de nas slob dpon gyis srin lag g.yon pas nang mchod nas slob ma rnams la nang mchod 'thor tshul byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba'i bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pas/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i mos pas thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / nang mchod nas bdud rtsi slob ma thams cad la gtor zhing / byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ sogs brjod/ thams cad la byin tshar ba dang / khyed rang rnams a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod cing myangs ba la brten nas/ mgrin pa na rtsa ya ra la wa zhes pa yi ge 'bru bzhi'i rnam par gnas pa la thim pas/ de nas rim gyis brgyud de lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun te/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ nga rgyal bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /sogs brjod/ de ltar na gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin de nyid la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams dgrol bar zhu/

de ltar na yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ces pa nas/ rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan dgos pas/ lung bstan thams cad sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skus mdzad pas/ slob dpon yang shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du 'phos te/ dbu rag zhabs rjen ngos/ chos gos kyi grwa gnyis seng ge'i rna ba ltar byas nas/ khyed rang rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas 'di lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan dgos pas/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /sogs brjod cing / rdor dril gnyis ka lag pa g.yas pas lhan cig bzung nas/ slob ma rnams kyi thad du dkrol zhing / kye zhes slob ma rnams la gsang mtshan dris pa'i mthar/ dper na/ dpal rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur+bhu wa swa/ 'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mdzad pa 'di ni sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthus yin no/ /zhes brjod cing rnam sbyar dang rdor dril bzhag de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sogs brjod/ gzengs bstod pa ni/ da khyed rnams srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing / myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas rang la dman pa'i blo yongs su spong la dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig de rnams kyis gsang dbang thob nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sogs brjod/ gdong ras bcing ba/ nang mchod gtor zhing bsrung ba sogs gsang dbang bzhin bya/

'on kyang rdzas gsang ba'i tshab kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar sogs 'dra/ de nas khyed rang rnams la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lo bcu drug lon pa re phyag rgyar gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /sogs brjod/ de ltar na rig ma gtad pa des khyed rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo nyams su len pa'i mthun rkyen sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyor ba la rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re nges par gus spro'i sgo nas bsten dgos pas/ de ltar spro mi spro brtag pa'i phyir dri ba mdzad pa yin te/ bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/ /sogs brjod/ de ltar dris pa'i lan gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /sogs brjod/ de ltar lan btab pa la brten nas rig ma de nyid rgyan dang bral ba/ lus nam mkha'i gos can du byas te gur gum la sogs pa'i dri zhim po'i chus byugs/ chu skyes rtsa mdzes pa'i bha ga bstan te/ pad+ma'i che ba brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ rmad byung nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de ltar pad+ma'i che ba brjod nas/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ rig ma'i phyag g.yon pa khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas par gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ /sogs brjod/ de ltar phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang ste sgom lam sa bcu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /de nas nyams myong dga' ba bzhi bskyed pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje gzhon nu dang / rig ma de yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa yum gyi mkha' ā las pad+ma ās mtshan pa/ yab kyi nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/

g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag rtse mor phaṭa yig ser po yab yum 'khyud pa dang / tsum+pa dang gsang gnas sbyar ba'i 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te/ thig le dwangs ma rnams zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar byon pas dga' ba/ dbus su byon pas mchog dga'/ rtsa gsum 'dom pa'i gnas su byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug par byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam du cung zad gcig mnyam par bzhag phyir ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzag par byas te/ rlung 'pho ba med pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas hūm̐ zhes pas yar drangs/ yab yum so so'i lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' ba/ yar drangs snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gang bas mchog dga'/ yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos nas lus kyi 'phrul 'khor dang / rlung dang / spyod lam la sogs pa'i sgo nas lus thams cad la khyab par bkram pa la brten nas/ lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la bde ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gis khyab pa ste/ bde stong zung 'jug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zad gcig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams dgrol bar zhu/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi zhes pa nas/ rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no zhes pa'i bar dkyus bzhin brjod de rtogs pa bskyed de/ de rnams kyis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/

/sogs lan gsum brjod/ gdong bcings/ bdud rtsi gtor nas 'bru gsum brjod/ de bsrung ba sogs gong bzhin la/ don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma gzigs pa'i brdar/ zhes sogs nas/ de nas dbang bzhi pa 'di la tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi dbang bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can la sogs pa mang du yod kyang / da lan dbang gsum pa'i dus su rig ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba la brten nas skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i dus su tshig gis ngo sprod pas na tshig dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ste/ de nyams su len par bya ba la khyed rang rnams rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba la sogs pa lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag yid kyis/ ji ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /sogs brjod/ de'i don 'di yin te/ brtan g.yo 'khor 'das ji ltar snang ba thams cad gang du'ang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can yin te/ de yang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs la bltas pa de'i tshe/ skye 'jig rtag chad/ 'gro 'ong thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin la/ de yang dang por skye ba rgyus stong / bar du gnas pa rang gi ngo bos stong / tha mar 'gags pa 'bras bus stong pa ste/ rnam par thar pa sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin can/ mdor na gsal ba'i dus na stong pa/ stong pa'i dus na gsal ba ste gsal stong zung 'jug gam/ bde bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du bde ba ste/ bde stong zung 'jug chen po gsal la mi rtog pa de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin rang byung ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams dgrol bar zhu/ de ltar don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes pa nas rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no zhes pa'i bar brjod/
